source.title: Milling scam — Mycobloom R1 vs R2 pigment yields

quote: I milled 20k+ herbs
notes: Author reports this as average R2 pigment units per Mycobloom herb, supported by the example of 1,000 herbs yielding 1,350 pigment from R2 Mycobloom. More than 20,000 herbs milled in total across unspecified rank-specific cohorts; completed mills per rank, total units per rank, Resourcefulness adjustment, skill, spec, hit counts and histograms are unknown. A commenter disputes the averages and suggests 1.1/1.3 without Resourcefulness; retain firsthand figures as historical source report, not a measured current baseline.
